Kit summary

Rapid IcicleBasic
Deals 380% ATK DMG to a single enemy. Each layer of [Glacier Mark] owned by Nilua increases ATK DMG of Rapid Icicle by 5%. Afterward, gains 1 layer of [Glacier Mark].
Splashing DropsActive
Summons 4 Glacier Stars to attack enemies randomly. The Glacier Star prioritizes attacking the main target, dealing 160% ATK DMG. When the Glacier Star lands a Crit, removes 1 layer of buff from the target. For every 3 layers of [Glacier Mark] owned by Nilua, summons 1 extra Glacier Star.
Pure UndercurrentPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Nilua is immune to [Silence] and [Provoke]. At the beginning of each wave, Nilua gains 6 layers of [Glacier Mark], 1 layer of which is consumed when any enemy acts. Each layer of [Glacier Mark] increases Nilua's Crit DMG by 7%, up to 12 layers, and will not be removed when she dies.
Glacier Fountainhead Lv.1At the end of all allies' turns, Nilua gains 1 layer of [Glacier Mark], each of which increases Piercing Rate by 5%.
Glacier Fountainhead Lv.3When Nilua has more than 5 layers of [Glacier Mark], for every 1 layer of them lost, increases Nilua's Turn Meter by 6%. When Nilua has less than 6 layers of [Glacier Mark], Nilua cleanses all debuffs from self and acts for 1 turn immediately. This effect can only be triggered once each wave.
Falling TurbulenceActiveExclusive Lv.2
Cleanses 1 layer of debuff from all allies. Afterward, deals 2 stages of 150% ATK DMG each to all enemies. The last stage deals extra 400% ATK DMG to the main target, which ignores [Shield], [Immortal], and [DMG Immunity]. If the extra DMG lands a Crit, reduces the main target's Turn Meter by 50%.
Glacier Fountainhead Lv.2When Nilua dies, she casts Falling Turbulence to the attacker for once. The effect can only be triggered again after Nilua revives and acts for 1 turn.
